parsed.reason: Both picks are real, named, drop-in venues in Montreal that a visiting family with a toddler could turn up to: the Biodôme and the Montréal Science Centre. Neither is a term or a weekly class. Each sourceName is the venue's own organisation (Espace pour la vie, Centre des sciences de Montréal), not an aggregator. Null prices are correct, and no figures look invented. Hours are attributed to the venue's own pages and dated honestly as October and fall schedules. The pick also flags that Dec 27–30 hours are unconfirmed, and that Dec 28 may be a closed Monday. Two picks for the post-Christmas window is reasonable. Small faults: the Biodôme ageFit leans on Tourisme Montréal, and its Monday-closure caveat comes from a museums listing rather than the venue. The Science Centre ageFit cites a third-party guide. These are secondary attributions inside otherwise venue-sourced picks, and they are transparently labelled. The bigger gap is that neither pick is confirmed open in the visit window. The Monday-closure flag is useful, but it leaves real uncertainty about whether the family can turn up on those dates. Solid finds, short of a clean 5.
